description: Upscales and enhances an image with optional face and color preservation (Topaz Image Enhance Reimagine).

prompt.description: Optional text prompt for creative upscaling guidance.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

crop_to_fill.description: By default, the image is letterboxed when the output aspect ratio differs. Enable to crop the image to fill the output dimensions.

face_enhancement_creativity.description: Set the creativity level for face enhancement.

face_enhancement_strength.description: Controls how sharp enhanced faces are relative to the background.

output_height.description: Zero value means to output in the same height as original or output width.

output_width.description: Zero value means to calculate automatically (usually it will be original size or output_height if specified).
